groups.saying_opens: كان الناس في عهد رسول الله
أن زيد بن ثابت لم يكن يبيع

notes: two sayings each with its own isnad (rule 4a): Zayd's report of the fruit sale, and Kharija's report of Zayd's practice; the second chain stops at Kharija because «أن زيد بن ثابت لم يكن يبيع» describes Zayd's act and does not relay his words (rule 6)
«قال أبو عبد الله رواه علي بن بحر» is the compiler's own remark: the compiler is not written; the chain it gives is a variant group
«كالمشورة يشير بها» is an explanatory gloss, not a name
